company: The GPT Group (GPT RE Limited and GPT Management Holdings Limited)
title: Securities Trading Policy
date_next_review: Reviewed annually by management; Board review every three years

tiers.name: KMP
tiers.description: Key Management Personnel of GPT as defined in Accounting Standard AASB 124 Related Party Disclosures. Subject to the trading windows, the section 5.2 prohibitions, notification of intention to deal, and the exceptional circumstances process.

tiers.name: Employees
tiers.description: Officers and employees of GPT. Subject to the same trading windows, section 5.2 prohibitions and notification obligations as KMP; the policy draws no substantive distinction between the two other than who receives the notification.

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: A KMP's and an Employee's family, related parties or associates, including related corporations, superannuation funds or investment vehicles where the KMP or Employee has influence over the related parties' judgement in relation to investment decisions. Expressly prohibited from dealing outside a Trading Window, and their intended dealings must be notified by the KMP or Employee.

tiers.name: The Chairman
tiers.description: The Chairman of the GPT Group Board; notifies the Chairman of the Audit Committee (copy to the General Counsel & Company Secretary) and applies to the Chairman of the Audit Committee for exceptional circumstances relief.

tiers.name: All other Directors
tiers.description: Directors other than the Chairman; notify the Chairman of the Board with a copy to the General Counsel & Company Secretary, must inform the Company Secretary within three business days after dealing, and are the subject of an ASX disclosure notice lodged within five business days.

tiers.name: The Executive Team
tiers.description: Members of the Executive Team; notify the Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director with a copy to the General Counsel & Company Secretary.

tiers.name: All other Employees
tiers.description: Employees outside the Board and Executive Team; must first notify the General Counsel & Company Secretary of an intention to deal.

definitions.hedging_definition: hedging or entering into an arrangement that would have the effect of limiting their exposure to risk relating to an element of their remuneration that is unvested, or which remains subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition

windows.start_anchor: the second trading day after the release of the GPT Group's annual results to the ASX
the second trading day after the release of the GPT Group's half year results to the ASX
the second trading day after the Annual General Meeting of GPT Securityholders
the second trading day after the release of GPT Group's third quarter operational update to the ASX
the second trading day after the provision by the Board of forecasts in an offer document released to the market
any additional period designated by the GPT Group Board from time to time

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The GPT Group Board may vary, suspend or terminate the availability of any Trading Window at any time, including for all KMP and Employees or only a subset of persons. Not confidential: GPT will provide KMPs and Employees with notification of the opening, closing, suspension and termination of Trading Windows.

rules.detail: Derivatives are never named. The definition of Securities lists shares, debentures, units or other interests in a scheme, options over unissued shares or units, and rights to subscribe: it does not include options or other derivatives written by third parties over issued GPT Securities. Dealing is confined to selling, otherwise disposing of or acquiring GPT Securities (or arranging someone else to do so) and transferring legal ownership. A bank-written OTC put or call over existing stapled securities therefore falls outside both definitions unless it hedges restricted remuneration or is part of a secured financing, and physical settlement would be a Dealing requiring a Trading Window and notification.
A put, collar or other derivative that limits exposure to risk on an unvested element of remuneration is banned outright with no window or clearance route, whatever the venue.
rules.evidence: hedging or entering into an arrangement that would have the effect of limiting their exposure to risk relating to an element of their remuneration that is unvested, or which remains subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition

rules.detail: Absolute prohibition on hedging or any arrangement limiting exposure to risk on unvested remuneration. No exemption, hardship or Board waiver is provided: section 9 relief runs only to selling or disposing of Securities outside a window.
rules.evidence: KMPs and Employees are prohibited from: ... hedging or entering into an arrangement that would have the effect of limiting their exposure to risk relating to an element of their remuneration that is unvested, or which remains subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition

rules.detail: Remuneration that has vested but remains subject to a trading restriction (holding lock or holding term) or a forfeiture condition is treated identically to unvested remuneration; hedging it is prohibited until the restriction and forfeiture condition fall away.
rules.evidence: an element of their remuneration that is unvested, or which remains subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition

rules.detail: The hedging prohibition is drafted by reference to remuneration that is unvested or still restricted, so it does not reach securities that have fully vested with no trading restriction or forfeiture condition, nor securities bought on market. Such a hedge is not prohibited, but it must not involve any security interest or secured financing over GPT Securities, must not be speculative or short-term, and any resulting acquisition, disposal or transfer of legal ownership must occur in a Trading Window after notification of intention to deal.
rules.evidence: hedging or entering into an arrangement that would have the effect of limiting their exposure to risk relating to an element of their remuneration that is unvested, or which remains subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named as such, but any monetisation that raises money against GPT Securities is caught: the fourth bullet of 5.2 bans margin loans using GPT Securities as security and 'any other secured financing arrangements in respect of GPT Securities' without qualification as to vesting or tier. Only a wholly unsecured hedge over fully vested, unrestricted securities escapes.
rules.evidence: obtaining margin loans using GPT Securities (either solely or as part of a portfolio) as security for the loans, or entering into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of GPT Securities.

rules.detail: Short selling GPT securities is named as a form of prohibited speculative dealing, banned at all times including within a Trading Window.
rules.evidence: KMPs and Employees are prohibited from: engaging in speculative dealing in GPT securities, being short-selling GPT securities and short-term dealing

rules.detail: Securities lending is not mentioned. The Dealing definition covers disposals, acquisitions and transfers of legal ownership, so a stock loan transferring title would be a Dealing needing a Trading Window and notification, but the policy does not address lending as such.

CFDs are not named. A CFD over GPT securities is speculative dealing and, if short, is economically a short sale; either characterisation is prohibited. A long CFD is not a Security under the definition and so is not otherwise regulated.
rules.evidence: engaging in speculative dealing in GPT securities, being short-selling GPT securities and short-term dealing

rules.detail: Margin loans secured on GPT Securities are banned, whether the securities stand alone or form part of a wider portfolio. No approval, hardship or grandfathering route is offered and the ban applies to KMP, Employees and, through section 2, their Associates.
rules.evidence: obtaining margin loans using GPT Securities (either solely or as part of a portfolio) as security for the loans

rules.detail: A dedicated bullet prohibits granting a security interest in respect of vested GPT Securities that remain subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition, whatever the purpose of the financial arrangement.
rules.evidence: entering into any financial arrangements whereby a security interest is granted in respect of any vested GPT Securities which remain subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition

rules.detail: For fully vested, unrestricted securities the security interest bullet does not apply, but the following bullet does: any secured financing arrangement in respect of GPT Securities is prohibited, so a charge or pledge to a lender is caught. A security interest granted otherwise than in connection with financing is not addressed and is not itself a Dealing.
rules.evidence: or entering into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of GPT Securities.

rules.detail: Blanket ban on any secured financing arrangement in respect of GPT Securities, extending well beyond margin lending. It is unqualified as to tier, vesting state, quantum or lender, there is no approval route, and the section 9 exceptional circumstances power is confined to selling or disposing of Securities.
rules.evidence: or entering into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of GPT Securities.

rules.detail: A hard 30 day rule: buying and then selling (or selling and then buying) any GPT securities within 30 days is prohibited short-term dealing, regardless of profit or intention. The only carve-out is for Securities acquired on the exercise or vesting of Securities under a GPT employee incentive scheme.
rules.evidence: short-term dealing (i.e. if a person buys (or sells) GPT securities on a date and then sells (or buys) any GPT securities on a date that is less than 30 days after the first dealing). The exception to this is regarding Securities acquired on the exercise or vesting of Securities under any GPT employee incentive scheme

clearance.approver: Chairman of the Audit Committee, with a copy to the General Counsel & Company Secretary
clearance.post_trade_to: Company Secretary (with information to enable the ASX disclosure)
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within three business days after dealing; ASX disclosure notice lodged within five business days
clearance.evidence: The Chairman must notify the Chairman of the Audit Committee with a copy to the General Counsel & Company Secretary

clearance.approver: Chairman of the Board, with a copy to the General Counsel & Company Secretary
clearance.post_trade_to: Company Secretary (with information to enable the ASX disclosure)
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within three business days after dealing; ASX disclosure notice lodged within five business days
clearance.evidence: A director must inform the Company Secretary within three business days after dealing in GPT Securities and must provide such other information to enable the relevant ASX disclosure to be made.

clearance.approver: Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director, with a copy to the General Counsel & Company Secretary
clearance.evidence: Each KMP and Employee must provide notification of an intention to deal by themselves or an Associate in GPT Securities prior to dealing in GPT Securities during a Trading Window. The notification must include confirmation that the KMP or Employee is not in possession of any inside information.

Any clearance provided under this section must be effected (even if not settled) within five business days of the date of the clearance. The person providing the clearance is able to deny clearance, apply conditions in their discretion and is not obliged to provide reasons for any direction or condition.

short_term.basis: 30 days between a buy and any subsequent sell, or a sell and any subsequent buy, of GPT securities
carve_outs: Securities acquired on the exercise or vesting of Securities under any GPT employee incentive scheme
short_term.evidence: short-term dealing (i.e. if a person buys (or sells) GPT securities on a date and then sells (or buys) any GPT securities on a date that is less than 30 days after the first dealing)

exceptions.evidence: Where the beneficial interest in the GPT Securities does not change.

Transfers of GPT Securities already held in a superannuation fund in which the KMP, Employee or Associate is a beneficiary and where the KMP, Employee or Associate does not exercise any influence or discretion over trading and the trading policy of the superannuation fund.
An investment or trading in units of diversified fund where the assets of the fund are invested at the discretion of a third party.

exceptions.approver: decision taken independently of the KMP, Employee or Associate
exceptions.evidence: Trading in GPT Securities by a trust of which the KMP, Employee or Associate is a trustee but not a beneficiary of the trust where any decision to trade during a prohibited period is taken independently of the KMP, Employee or Associate.
Undertakings to accept, or the acceptance of, a takeover offer.

exceptions.approver: Board approves the plan that determines the timing and structure of the offer
exceptions.evidence: Trading under an offer or invitation made to all or most of the Securityholders, such as, a rights issue, a security purchase plan, dividend or distribution reinvestment plan and an equal access buy-back, where the plan that determines the timing and structure of the offer has been approved by the Board.

The acceptance of an invitation to participate in a GPT employee security plan and vesting (but not any subsequent sale) of GPT's securities as a result of meeting performance hurdles or release of GPT securities from holding lock or holding term in respect of securities received as part of performance-based remuneration.
Cancellation of GPT Securities as a result of failure to vest or other forfeiture of Securities received by individuals as part of performance-based remuneration.

exceptions.approver: General Counsel and Company Secretary (Chief Executive Officer where the applicant is the General Counsel and Company Secretary); the Chairman for Directors; the Chairman of the Audit Committee for the Chairman
exceptions.evidence: If a KMP or Employee needs to sell or dispose of GPT Securities outside of a trading window, due to exceptional circumstances they may apply in writing ... Severe financial hardship where the sale of Securities is the only practical method of overcoming hardship

exceptions.approver: General Counsel and Company Secretary, the Chairman, or the Chairman of the Audit Committee as applicable
exceptions.evidence: A requirement to deal in Securities pursuant to a court order or a court enforceable undertaking; or An overriding legal or regulatory requirement to transfer or accept a transfer of Securities.

external_documents: Accounting Standard AASB 124 Related Party Disclosures (definition of KMP)
GPT employee incentive scheme and GPT employee security plan rules (source of trading restrictions, holding locks and forfeiture conditions)
exemption_authority: Section 9 permits a KMP or Employee who needs to sell or dispose of GPT Securities outside a Trading Window in exceptional circumstances to apply in writing to the General Counsel and Company Secretary (to the CEO where the applicant is the General Counsel and Company Secretary), to the Chairman in the case of Directors, and to the Chairman of the Audit Committee in the case of the Chairman. It requires sufficient evidence that selling or disposing is the most reasonable course of action and a declaration of no inside information, and the approver may deny or impose conditions without reasons. The power extends only to selling or disposing of Securities: there is no authority to waive the section 5.2 prohibitions on hedging, security interests, margin loans or other secured financing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: KMPs and Employees are prohibited from ... obtaining margin loans using GPT Securities (either solely or as part of a portfolio) as security for the loans, or entering into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of GPT Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is decisive: the loan leg of a funded collar, secured on the collared securities, is prohibited outright for every KMP, Employee and Associate with no vesting carve-out and no approval or hardship route.

bespoke_clauses.topic: security interest over restricted vested securities
bespoke_clauses.clause: entering into any financial arrangements whereby a security interest is granted in respect of any vested GPT Securities which remain subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even a financing that was not otherwise 'secured financing' cannot take a security interest over vested securities still under a holding lock or forfeiture condition, so no part of the restricted holding can be pledged.

bespoke_clauses.clause: hedging or entering into an arrangement that would have the effect of limiting their exposure to risk relating to an element of their remuneration that is unvested, or which remains subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The hedging prohibition is tied to restricted remuneration, so an unfunded collar over fully vested, unrestricted securities is not itself banned; only the funding and security elements are.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Securities: Includes: shares or debentures in a company or unit or other interest in a scheme; an option over an unissued share, or debenture of, the company; ... Dealing: To: Sell (or otherwise dispose) or acquire GPT Securities or arrange someone else to do so whether on or off market; and Transfer legal ownership of Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Third-party derivatives over issued GPT Securities are not within the defined terms, so an OTC option is regulated only through the hedging and secured financing bullets, while any physical settlement is squarely a Dealing needing a Trading Window and notification.

bespoke_clauses.clause: short-term dealing (i.e. if a person buys (or sells) GPT securities on a date and then sells (or buys) any GPT securities on a date that is less than 30 days after the first dealing)
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A mechanical matching rule with no intention element: any share purchase or sale within 30 days on either side of a physically settled leg breaches the policy, so settlement timing must be mapped against all other dealings.

bespoke_clauses.clause: KMPs, Employees and Associates are prohibited from dealing in GPT Securities during all periods that are outside an available trading window.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is a positive-permission regime with five six-week windows a year, so entry, settlement or unwind of any structure must be scheduled inside a window that has not been suspended.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The availability of any Trading Window may be varied, suspended or terminated by the GPT Group Board at any time, including being varied for all KMP and Employees or a subset of persons.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The Board can close a window for one individual without notice to the market, which can strand a partially executed structure or block a scheduled settlement.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Receipt of a notification of intention to deal and any clearance provided is intended as a compliance monitoring function only and is not endorsement or approval of the proposed dealing.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A bank cannot treat a GPT clearance as company approval of the structure; the executive bears full responsibility and a clearance carries no comfort that the arrangement complies with 5.2.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any breach of this Policy or failure to act within the spirit of this Policy will be viewed seriously and will be subject to disciplinary action which may include termination of employment with GPT.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Structuring around the literal words of the secured financing ban, for example through a non-recourse prepaid forward or a third-party funder, would still be judged against the spirit of the policy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: extends to a KMP's and an Employee's family, related parties or associates, including related corporations, superannuation funds or investment vehicles where the KMP or Employee has influence over the related parties' judgement in relation to investment decisions
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Booking the collar or the loan in a family trust, controlled company or self-managed fund does not avoid the secured financing prohibition or the window restriction.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Any clearance provided under this section must be effected (even if not settled) within five business days of the date of the clearance.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any dealing leg must be executed within five business days of notification, and the approver may impose conditions in their discretion without giving reasons.

summary: A funded collar is not possible under this policy. Section 5.2 prohibits KMP, Employees and their Associates from obtaining margin loans using GPT Securities as security and from entering into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of GPT Securities, an unqualified ban with no vesting carve-out, no approval route and no waiver power, so the loan leg secured on the collared securities is prohibited outright. A separate bullet bans granting a security interest over vested securities that remain subject to a trading restriction or forfeiture condition, and hedging is prohibited for any element of remuneration that is unvested or still restricted. The unfunded derivative legs over fully vested, unrestricted securities are not themselves banned, and indeed sit largely outside the narrow definitions of Securities and Dealing, but any physical settlement, and any acquisition or disposal in connection with the structure, must occur inside one of the five six-week Trading Windows, must be preceded by a notification of intention to deal to the applicable approver (Chairman of the Audit Committee for the Chairman, Chairman of the Board for other Directors, the CEO for the Executive Team, the General Counsel & Company Secretary for everyone else), must be effected within five business days of clearance, and must not fall within 30 days of any other buy or sell. Section 9 relief is confined to selling or disposing of Securities in exceptional circumstances and cannot authorise any part of the financing.
